newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi fall pulls down brokerage sector in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi fall pulls down brokerage sector in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd fell in early Tokyo morning trade on Thursday, helping drag down the brokerage sector overall, brokers said.

As of 0048 GMT, Yamaichi shares were down 16 yen at 354 in turnover of 629,000. Other securities shares were also down, with Daiwa Securities Co Ltd shedding 23 yen to 859 yen. Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd also slid 10 yen to 1,380 yen.

Brokers said Yamaichi shares were depressed by news on Wednesday that Moody's Investors Service had placed Yamaichi's Baa3 and Prime-3 ratings under review for possible downgrade. This had a psychologically negative impact on the brokerage sector.
